subject.title: feat(mac): swap dashboard titlebar buttons with sidebar state

question: Should the macOS dashboard adopt adaptive native titlebar controls driven by Control UI sidebar state as a maintained cross-version contract?
rationale: Code review can establish correctness, but only maintainers can accept the persistent native navigation design and long-term bridge contract represented by this protected feature PR.

options.title: Adopt adaptive titlebar
options.body: Accept the state-aware controls, canonical web actions, and legacy fallback as the supported macOS dashboard design.

options.title: Keep fixed navigation
options.body: Retain the current toggle/back/forward controls and address hidden-navigation access through another UI surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt adaptive titlebar
recommendation.body: Accept the state-aware controls, canonical web actions, and legacy fallback as the supported macOS dashboard design.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history covers the titlebar bridge and surrounding macOS dashboard design this decision extends.
